scope: Actual full two-coordinate collision in the fixed j=1 common-log cell
proved: At fixed global M, integral rows are s>=1, 4s<=M-5, s congruent to M+1 modulo 3, with p=(4M+2s+1)/3 and h=(M-4s-2)/3.
Actual prime rows are exactly the primes (4M+3)/3 <= p <= (3M-1)/2.
The raw logarithmic support is M/6+o(M), or 1/36 per 6M.
The j=1 phase interval is disjoint from every other fixed-j phase interval at the same M.
The actual full gate is Q0=Q1=0, equivalently p^2 divides both fixed integers C0(M),C1(M).
The available square-divisor Cauchy-height ceiling is H/2=3.1638137727... per M, weaker than raw 1/6.

When bounded-degree algebraic recombinations of the same fixed-M pair are estimated only by the inherited componentwise Cauchy bound, they certify no improvement over the H/2 height-to-valuation ratio; a separately proved low-height cancellation remains open.
At the existing height, a same-integer valuation multiplicity at least 38 would be needed merely to beat raw support.
The Item-248 Wronskian and individual Item-245 leading seeds are not substitutes for the full two-coordinate gate.
The fixed h<=8 all-prime exclusion removes only O(log M)=o(M) weight.
